ABOUT.TEXT1: What drives me is the blend of creativity, logic, and teamwork. I enjoy bringing things to life with code.
ABOUT.TEXT2: I value building projects that not only work in the short term, but also last over time.

WORKS.TITLE: Portfolio
WORKS.INTRO: Here I present a selection of my work – interactive projects show you my skills in action.

ELPOLLO.TITLE: El Pollo Loco
ELPOLLO.DESC: El Pollo Loco is a browser jump-and-run game where you control a character, collect coins and bottles, and face chickens as enemies. At the end, a big boss awaits, who must be defeated with the collected bottles.

POKEDEX.TITLE: PokeDex
POKEDEX.DESC: The Pokedex is a web app that displays Pokémon with images, names, and details such as type or abilities. Data is loaded via the PokéAPI and clearly presented in card form.
